title: LaserCalc preliminary cutting-mode database
notes: This is a preliminary reference database, not a production-ready technology library.
Speeds are approximate central values based on overlapping published 3 kW tables where available; ranges preserve source variation. They are not a statistical average across fully matched machines.
The LaserLandServis /cutmodes numeric rows could not be retrieved in this session. No record is falsely attributed to that site.
Published tables differ in source, fiber core, optics, head, nozzle, gas purity/pressure, material grade and quality target. Compare only matching gas and thickness records.
Only exact material/thickness/power/gas combinations in records are explicit database entries. Missing combinations must not be treated as validated.
The calculator's selected speed estimates only straight cutting time; pierces, leads, acceleration, corners, rapid moves and CAM sequence still need calibration from CypCut and actual machine time.
